levels.surface: أحمد بن أبي عبد الله البرقي

notes: «أبيه محمد بن خالد»: أبيه with a name is one link, the name alone (rule 7).
«باسناده رفعه إلى» is a gap the text does not name: unnamed (rule 8).
The Imam is named after «إلى» and then speaks («قال»): last link as imam_in_text (owner ruling 2), not as a narrator.
«5-40» and «رضي الله عنه» are left out.
